Beyond Traffic

More Than Traffic. Visibility That Supports Business Goals.

Traffic on its own is a weak measure of success. What matters is whether the right people find your business at the moment they are ready to choose a provider, and whether what they find is clear enough to act on.

Irshadify starts by identifying where your search visibility opportunities actually are: the searches your buyers make, the questions they ask, and the AI answers they read. Why SEO Is Still the Most Reliable Growth Channel

Paid ads stop the moment your budget stops. SEO keeps working. When your website ranks for the searches your customers are already making, you earn trust, traffic and leads without paying for every click.

But SEO today is not about stuffing keywords or buying cheap links. Search engines reward websites that are fast, helpful, well structured and trusted. That is exactly how we build and optimize every website we work on.

At Irshadify, we combine technical expertise, strategic content and ethical link acquisition to help your brand show up where it matters: in front of people ready to buy.

Is This SEO Service Right for You?

Our SEO service is built for:

  • B2B companies and SaaS brands that need qualified leads, not just traffic
  • Service businesses that want to dominate their city or region
  • E-commerce and online brands that want more organic sales
  • Startups that need a strong search foundation from day one
  • International businesses targeting customers in the USA, UK, Europe, the Middle East and beyond
  • Businesses that were hurt by bad SEO and need a clean, safe recovery plan

Our SEO Services, Explained

Keyword Research and Search Intent Mapping

Every strong SEO campaign starts with knowing exactly what your customers search for. We research the keywords that bring real buyers, not just high-volume vanity terms.

What you get:

  • Full keyword research report (primary, secondary and long-tail keywords)

On-Page SEO Optimization

On-page SEO tells search engines exactly what each page is about and makes it a better experience for visitors.

What you get:

SEO Content Writing

Content is what ranks, earns links and convinces visitors to act. Our writers produce original, helpful content shaped around search intent and your brand voice.

What you get:

  • Service and landing page copy that ranks and converts
  • Blog articles and pillar guides
  • Content briefs built from competitor and SERP analysis
  • Content refreshes for older pages that lost rankings
  • Content that is clear, original and written for people first

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does SEO take to show results?

Most websites begin to see early improvements in 2 to 3 months, with stronger results between 4 and 6 months. The timeline depends on your competition, website age, current condition and the consistency of the work.

Can you guarantee first-page rankings?

No ethical SEO agency can guarantee specific rankings because search engines control the results. What we guarantee is a transparent, white-hat strategy, consistent execution and honest reporting.

What is the difference between SEO and paid ads?

Paid ads bring traffic only while you pay. SEO builds long-term visibility that keeps delivering traffic after the work is done. Many businesses use both, but SEO usually gives a lower cost per lead over time.

Do you offer SEO for international markets?

Yes. We research keywords and competitors in the specific country and language you want to target and optimize your site accordingly.

Do I need to have a website already?

Not necessarily. If you have a website, we audit and improve it. If you are building a new one, we can guide the SEO structure from the start so you avoid expensive fixes later.

What do you need from me to get started?

Access to your website, Google Search Console and Google Analytics (if available), a short overview of your business, and your main goals. We guide you through the rest.

How do you build backlinks?

We use ethical methods only: guest posts on relevant sites, outreach, digital PR and link reclamation. We never use link farms, private blog networks or paid link schemes.

Will I get reports?

Yes. You receive a clear monthly report and a review call to discuss progress and next steps.

Do you also write the content?

Yes. Our content team writes service pages, blog posts and guides optimized for both search engines and readers.

Search Is Changing. Is Your Brand Visible in AI Answers?

A growing number of buyers no longer scroll through ten blue links. They ask an AI assistant a question and trust the answer they get. If your brand is not part of that answer, you are invisible at the exact moment a customer is deciding.

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of making your brand, content and expertise easy for AI systems to find, understand, trust and cite. It builds on strong SEO, but goes further: clear entities, authoritative content, consistent brand signals and structured information that AI models can confidently use.

At Irshadify, we help you show up in AI-generated answers, not only in traditional search results.

GEO in Plain Language

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) means optimizing your brand and content so AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews mention, cite or recommend you in their answers.

Traditional SEO helps you rank in a list of links. GEO helps you appear inside the answer itself.

GEO does not replace SEO. A strong SEO foundation makes GEO work better, and we handle both together.

Is GEO Right for Your Business?

Our GEO service is built for:

  • B2B and SaaS companies whose buyers research solutions using AI tools
  • Agencies and consultants who want to be recommended as experts in their niche
  • Professional service providers (legal, finance, healthcare, real estate and similar)
  • E-commerce and DTC brands that want to appear in AI product recommendations
  • International businesses that want visibility in AI answers across different countries
  • Brands already doing SEO that want to stay ahead as search behavior shifts

Frequently Asked Questions

What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is the practice of optimizing your brand and content so AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can find, understand, trust and cite you in their answers.

What is the difference between SEO, GEO and AEO?

SEO helps you rank in search results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) helps you win direct answers such as featured snippets and voice results. GEO helps your brand appear in answers generated by AI tools. The three work best together.

Can you guarantee that ChatGPT will mention my brand?

No. AI tools generate answers independently and results can change. No honest agency can guarantee mentions. What we do is improve every signal that increases your chances and measure progress transparently.

How long does GEO take to show results?

Some improvements, such as better content structure and schema, can influence visibility within weeks. Authority and mention building usually take 3 to 6 months or longer. Timelines depend on your industry and competition.

Do I need good SEO before GEO?

Strong SEO helps a lot, because many AI tools use search results and trusted web sources to find information. If your SEO is weak, we can fix both together.

Which AI tools do you optimize for?

We focus on the ones your audience uses most, typically ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

How do you measure GEO success?

We track a fixed set of buyer-style prompts over time and measure how often your brand is mentioned, how it is described, whether you are cited with a link, and any traffic or leads coming from AI tools.

Is GEO safe? Does it break any rules?

Yes, when done properly. We use only white-hat methods: helpful content, clear structure, honest brand signals and ethical outreach. We never use hidden text, fake reviews or manipulation.

Can GEO help my local or international business?

Yes. We tailor prompts, content and brand signals to the countries and languages you want to target.

More Searches Now End Without a Click. Are You in the Answer?

Today, people type or speak a question and get an instant answer at the top of the page, in a featured snippet, a People Also Ask box, a voice reply or an AI summary. Often they never visit a website at all.

That changes what visibility means. The brands that supply those answers earn trust, brand recall and qualified visits. The brands that do not are simply skipped.

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is how you structure your content, your pages and your data so search engines and AI tools can pick your answer first.

At Irshadify, we plan, write and mark up your content so it becomes the clear, trusted answer to the questions your buyers ask.

AEO in Plain Language

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) means optimizing your content so it is selected as the direct answer in featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search results, knowledge panels and AI-generated summaries.

Traditional SEO helps you rank as a link. AEO helps you be the answer shown above the links.

AEO and GEO are close relatives. AEO focuses on direct answers in search results and voice assistants, while GEO focuses on being recommended inside AI chat tools. We often run both together.

Is AEO Right for Your Business?

Our AEO service is built for:

  • B2B and SaaS companies whose buyers research definitions, comparisons and how-to questions
  • Service businesses that want to answer "how much," "how long" and "who is best" questions in their niche
  • Local businesses that want to win "near me" and voice search queries
  • Content-heavy websites and publishers that want more visibility from existing articles
  • E-commerce brands that want to answer product and comparison questions
  • Brands already doing SEO that want to capture more of the search page

Our AEO Services, Explained

Question Research and Answer Opportunity Audit

We start by finding the exact questions your audience asks and where answers are up for grabs.

What you get:

  • Research of questions from search results, People Also Ask, forums and customer conversations
  • Grouping of questions by topic, intent and funnel stage
  • Review of which questions already show snippets or answer boxes
  • Identification of snippets your competitors own that you can realistically take
  • Prioritized list of answer opportunities by impact and effort

Question-Based Content Creation

Content that answers the question clearly and completely is content that gets chosen.

What you get:

  • Pages and articles built around real buyer questions
  • Direct answer first: a short, clear answer (usually 40 to 60 words) right under the question heading, followed by deeper explanation
  • Question-style headings (H2 and H3) that match how people search
  • Clear definitions, steps, comparisons and examples
  • Expert insight and original details that make your answer more useful than others

Featured Snippet Optimization

Featured snippets sit at the top of the page. We format your content to compete for them.

What you get:

  • Formatting for paragraph snippets, list snippets (steps and rankings) and table snippets
  • Optimization of existing pages that already rank on page one for the best chance of capturing a snippet
  • Clean HTML structure that search engines can easily extract
  • Tracking of snippet wins and losses over time

FAQ Creation and FAQ Schema

Well-written FAQs are one of the most effective ways to answer many questions on a single page.

What you get:

  • FAQ sections added to key service, product and blog pages
  • Questions chosen from real search data, not guesses
  • Concise, trustworthy answers written in your brand voice
  • FAQPage structured data added correctly and validated
  • Honest approach: Google now shows FAQ rich results only in limited cases, so we write FAQs mainly to serve users and answer engines, not just for a visual result

Schema Markup and Structured Data

Structured data helps machines understand and trust your content.

What you get:

  • Implementation of FAQPage, HowTo (where still supported and useful), Article, Organization, Service, Product, LocalBusiness and BreadcrumbList schema
  • Author and publisher information to support trust
  • Testing with Google's Rich Results Test and Schema Markup Validator
  • Ongoing checks for schema errors in Google Search Console

Frequently Asked Questions

What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?

AEO is the practice of optimizing your content so search engines, voice assistants and AI tools choose it as the direct answer to a question, such as in featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes and voice results.

What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?

SEO helps your pages rank in search results. AEO helps your content become the direct answer shown at the top of results and in voice search. GEO helps your brand get mentioned and recommended inside AI chat tools. Together they cover the full search journey.

What is a featured snippet?

A featured snippet is a highlighted answer box shown at the top of Google results. It pulls a short paragraph, list or table from a web page that answers the search clearly.

Can you guarantee a featured snippet?

No. Search engines choose snippets automatically and results can change. We cannot honestly guarantee placement, but we improve every factor that raises your chances and track the outcome openly.

Does AEO bring less traffic if people get answers without clicking?

Some questions will produce fewer clicks, which is why we target questions where your brand gains authority, trust and qualified visits, and where users still need to click for depth. Being the source also builds brand recognition.

How long does AEO take to show results?

Pages that already rank on page one can win snippets within weeks after optimization. New content usually takes 3 to 6 months to build visibility. Timelines depend on competition and site strength.

Do I need good SEO before AEO?

Strong SEO helps, because answers usually come from pages that already rank well. If your SEO needs work, we can improve both together.

Does AEO help with voice search?

Yes. Voice assistants usually read one short answer from a trusted source. Clear, concise, well-structured answers and strong local information improve your chances.

Do you write the content too?

Yes. Our content team writes question-based pages, FAQs and guides, and our developers or partners add the schema markup.

Article image, placeholder

Most business owners meet this topic the same way: a customer mentions it, a competitor shows up where they should be, or a tool gives an answer that does not include them. The details differ, but the underlying shift is the same. Buyers are researching earlier, asking fuller questions, and trusting the sources that answer clearly and consistently.

The practical response is not complicated, but it does need to be deliberate. Your website has to state plainly what you do, who it is for, and why you are a safe choice, in language a machine can parse and a person can enjoy reading. Pages that bury the answer under vague marketing language lose to pages that answer directly.

Start with the questions your customers actually ask before they buy. Write the clearest answer you can, put it where it belongs on the page, and support it with the surrounding detail: process, deliverables, proof where you have it, and an easy next step. Then keep your business information consistent everywhere it appears, so every system that reads it reaches the same conclusion.

This is slow work compared to an ad campaign, and that is exactly why it compounds. Every clear page and every accurate listing makes the next one more effective. Businesses that start now are building the presence that search results, answer boxes and AI tools will draw on for years.

SEO Services

What is SEO and how does it help my business?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process of improving your website so it ranks higher in search results like Google. Higher rankings bring more qualified visitors without paying for each click, which leads to more leads, sales and brand trust over time.

What does your SEO service include?

Our SEO service starts with a website audit, followed by keyword and competitor research, on-page optimization, content recommendations and regular reporting. The exact scope depends on your website and goals, and we agree it with you before we start.

How long does SEO take to show results?

Most websites see early movement in 3 to 4 months, with stronger results at 6 to 12 months. Timing depends on competition, site age, content quality and past issues. We share progress twice a month so you can see what is changing.

Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

No. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings, because search engines control them. What we guarantee is a clear strategy, quality work, transparent reporting and steady effort toward your goals.

GEO and AEO Services

What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is the practice of making your brand and content easy for AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to find, understand and cite. It focuses on clear answers, strong brand signals and mentions on trusted websites.

What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?

AEO means structuring your content so search engines and AI assistants can pull direct answers from it. This includes question-style headings, short answer-first paragraphs, FAQs and structured data, so your pages are chosen as the answer.

How is GEO different from SEO?

SEO aims to rank your pages in search results. GEO aims to get your brand mentioned or cited inside AI-generated answers. They overlap heavily, and good SEO is still the foundation, because AI answers often draw from sites that already perform well in search.

Can you guarantee my brand will appear in ChatGPT or Google AI answers?

No. AI systems decide what to cite, and no agency controls that. We improve your chances by strengthening your content, brand signals and third-party mentions, and we track how often your brand appears for buyer-style prompts.

How do you measure GEO and AEO results?

We build a list of buyer-style prompts, run them across tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Mode, and record whether your brand is mentioned and how you compare with competitors. We repeat this regularly to track change.

B2B White Label Services for Agencies

What is white label SEO?

White label SEO means we do the SEO work and you deliver it to your clients under your own brand. Your client sees your agency, while our team handles the research, optimization and reporting behind the scenes.

Who is white label SEO for?

It suits web design, marketing and development agencies that want to offer SEO, GEO and AEO without hiring an in-house team. It lets you add a service, keep your client relationships and scale without extra payroll.

Will you contact my clients directly?

No. We work only through you, and we keep your client relationships and project details confidential. You stay the single point of contact for your clients.

Our culture and values

Honest advice, always

We tell clients the truth about what search can and cannot do, even when it means recommending less work. The same honesty applies inside the team.

Clarity over hype

Remote-first, across time zones

We work with clients and collaborators internationally. Good written communication and respect for time-zone differences are part of the craft.

Always learning

Search, answers and AI platforms change constantly. Curiosity and steady learning are expected, and supported.

Information we collect

How we use your information

To review and respond to your enquiry, to prepare a proposal or quotation, to deliver services you engage us for, to assess expressions of interest for future roles, and to keep this website secure and working. We do not sell your information, and we do not share it for third-party marketing.

Cookie Policy

How this website uses cookies, and the control you have over them.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored on your device by a website. They help the site work, remember choices you make, and, only with permission, help the site owner understand how the site is used.

Essential cookies

These are needed for the website to function, for example security and load balancing, and remembering your cookie choice itself. They are always active and do not track you for marketing.

Analytics cookies

If you accept in the cookie banner, analytics cookies help us understand which pages are useful and how visitors move through the site, so we can improve it. They stay off until you accept, and you can decline without affecting your use of the site.

Marketing cookies

If advertising or remarketing tools are added to this website in future, their cookies will be listed here and will also stay off until you accept them. None are active by default.

The specific cookies in use

A table of the exact cookies set by the live website, their purpose and how long they last, will be published here once the final tools are confirmed. Cookie list, to be added

How to control cookies

You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's cookies in your browser, which will show the banner again, or by blocking cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site working properly.

Changes to this policy

If the tools this website uses change, this policy will be updated and, where consent is legally required, asked for again.
